name: Composer
author: hundekraft
description: Pick a style and hold a key: Composer writes a whole song, with verse, chorus and bridge and proper chord changes. There are 32 styles, from deep house and drum & bass to bossa nova and film noir, and each brings its own chords, grooves and song form. A song is built from 8-bar sections: A is the verse, B the chorus (the drop in club styles), C the bridge (the break in club styles, funk and nu-disco). Pop runs A A B A B C B B, lo-fi just A A B A.
